style: Create one original small spot illustration for the Yaqeen iOS app, matching the provided character reference: imperfect dark charcoal pencil contours, cream fill with sparse dry colored-pencil texture, muted moss-green accents and occasional warm ochre. The same cream cat has charcoal ears, a charcoal patch over one eye, long charcoal tail, tiny dot eyes, small triangular nose, two whiskers per cheek, small moss-green neckerchief. Simple bold silhouette, legible at 32 points on screen. Clean centered square, subject fills 80 percent, generous empty margin. Perfectly flat opaque pure white background, with pencil texture only within the subject. No writing, no UI, no logos, no glossy rendering, no gradients, no exaggerated kawaii eyes. Input image is a character and medium reference only.
